title: Monday · Peace artwork and a no-laptop afternoon
arrival: Settle in after lunch and get your peace artwork or existing paper work ready.
note: Updated from Daryl’s classroom reports on November 9: the morning was used for SpacesEDU postings, and the planned mathematics lesson was deferred to allow extended posting time. No laptops are available this afternoon. Afternoon: quiet reset, finish existing peace artwork, then existing paper work or quiet reading. Carry unfinished SpacesEDU postings and digital Bloxels work forward to a later school device session; no new homework or posting deadline is added. Follow school Diwali arrangements without inventing an event time. Keep cleanup around 2:00 and dismissal at 2:35. Remembrance assembly timing remains unconfirmed.
reflection: Morning: SpacesEDU postings. Mathematics deferred in favour of extended posting time.

blocks.title: Welcome and attendance
blocks.notes: Take attendance before forms. Check TTOC notes, artwork and the book/audio bookmark before deciding where to continue.
studentSteps: Answer attendance, then hand in any forms.
Look at today's plan and get your existing work ready.

blocks.title: SpacesEDU postings
blocks.notes: Daryl confirmed the morning was used for SpacesEDU. Do not infer that every posting was completed.

blocks.title: Snack
blocks.firstAction: Have your snack and tidy your space.

blocks.title: Extended SpacesEDU postings
blocks.notes: Replaces the planned mathematics block at Daryl’s direction. Finish existing work and use feedback; no new assignment or deadline.
blocks.firstAction: Find the existing posting you need to finish.
studentSteps: Add the work and reflection requested for that activity.
Check your pages are clear and ask for help where needed.

blocks.title: Lunch
blocks.firstAction: Follow our outside-play and lunch routine.

blocks.title: Quiet reset
blocks.firstAction: Choose quiet reading, drawing or another calm activity.

blocks.title: Finish peace artwork
blocks.notes: Continue the existing peace artwork with paper and art materials. Finish the large poster or individual version as directed; do not start a new art project. Keep personal experiences of war, grief and loss optional. Make room for confirmed school Diwali arrangements. Students whose art is finished may continue existing paper work or read quietly. No laptops or uploads are needed.
blocks.firstAction: Get your existing peace artwork and choose the part you need to finish.
studentSteps: Finish the part of your artwork your teacher identifies.
Check that your words, images and details communicate your idea about peace.
Show your progress and put the artwork where your teacher directs.
If finished, choose existing paper work or quiet reading.

blocks.title: Quiet work and reading
blocks.notes: Continue existing paper work using feedback, finish the peace artwork if needed, or read quietly. Check in with students who need help choosing a manageable next step. Defer digital Bloxels work and SpacesEDU uploads until a later school device session; do not add a new task or deadline.
blocks.firstAction: Choose existing paper work to finish or a book to read.
studentSteps: Find where you stopped and choose one useful next step.
Work quietly, or read your chosen book.
Mark where to continue and put your work away safely.

blocks.title: Tidy and movement break
blocks.notes: Put paper work and artwork away safely and complete classroom jobs. Take a separate short movement break after tidying; movement is not labelled cleanup. Record only confirmed reminders.
blocks.firstAction: Put your work away safely and complete your classroom job.
studentSteps: Return materials and tidy your space.
Join the separate movement break when directed.

blocks.title: Pack up and dismissal
blocks.firstAction: Check your belongings and get ready for a calm departure.

backups: Follow confirmed school Diwali arrangements; no event time is assumed.
The planned fraction lesson is deferred, not recorded as taught.
No laptops this afternoon: use existing artwork, paper work and books. Continue unfinished SpacesEDU postings and digital Bloxels work during a later school device session.
Carry unfinished work forward at school without adding a homework or upload deadline.
